metric_definitions.open_loop: Mean over clips of independent per-metric minima over samples 0:6; ADE/FDE in meters, trajectory horizon 6.4 s.
metric_definitions.collision_at_fault: Fraction of rollouts with collision_at_fault=1; stored as fraction, tables show percent.
metric_definitions.offroad: Fraction of rollouts with offroad=1; stored as fraction, tables show percent.
metric_definitions.progress: Mean progress_clipped_rel over all rollouts; ratio relative to the full GT trajectory, not a percent.
metric_definitions.closed_score: Average the two rollout scores in each scene, then average over scenes. Main/expert MLP: 150 scenes (300 rollouts); Hard100: 100 scenes (200 rollouts).
metric_definitions.hard100_missing_metrics: Hard100 contains missing observations. See hard100.aggregation for the historical denominator and progress convention; common_observed uses 96 scenes (192 rollouts) for every metric.
metric_definitions.lingo_pct: Native VQA, unprompted, Lingo-Judge accuracy over 500 questions.
metric_definitions.composition_parentheses: Performance cells show absolute mean (signed change from Dual). Rate changes are percentage points; other changes use the metric's original unit.
